text: The physical layer. Don't worry, we will focus mostly on the MAC layer, and the MAC layer has slightly changed over the different evolutions. So, it will not be too complicated, okay? But just to know that at the physical layer, so here the functions that allow us to modulate the signal and then transmit the signal, has become more and more complex as the Wi-Fi technology has evolved. Right now, we are using, as you can see, OFDM. Okay, OFDM is the most used modulation, it means orthogonal frequency, um, multiple modulation, and we are going to explain how how it works. It is used also in cellular communications, so it's very very popular, it's very efficient. But you can also see that through the years, I mean through the different evolutions, they have they have something more than OFDM. Okay, they have OFDM plus MIMO, and we are going to see what that is. They have got OFDM plus multiuser MIMO and many other things. So the physical layer has become more and more sophisticated in order to improve how the signal is actually transmitted over the air. Okay, and in parallel with these evolutions, so.
